ev.q: the plant community that would eventually cover a piece of land if people left it alone

1.why: B段。based his work on the vegetation that an area would support without human interference ↔ potential natural vegetation: the plant community that would eventually cover a piece of land if people left it alone。F 是陷阱：只种几种商业树种的是 plantations，正是 Miyawaki 反对的做法。

ev.q: Because the young trees compete fiercely for light, they tend to grow upwards rapidly

2.why: C段。pushes young trees to grow tall quickly ↔ tend to grow upwards rapidly；in the struggle for light ↔ compete fiercely for light。

ev.q: have rarely been tested independently under controlled conditions

3.why: D段。doubts that the best-known claims have been properly checked ↔ is cautious about such figures … rarely been tested independently。A 是瑞典研究的结论，不是 Benz 本人的观点。

ev.q: the trees had grown no faster than those in ordinary plantations

4.why: D段。found no evidence that the trees developed more quickly than usual ↔ had grown no faster than those in ordinary plantations。

ev.q: they were colonised by a wide variety of insects within two years of planting

5.why: E段。observed that new sites soon became home to many kinds of insect ↔ colonised by a wide variety of insects within two years。C 是过度推断：Harding 强调降温效果 is very local，只限于森林周围。

ev.q: argues that the greatest benefit is the sense of connection with nature, and with neighbours, that the projects create

6.why: F段。matter most for the people who take part ↔ the greatest benefit is the sense of connection … residents who took part。担心资金被转移的是 Some ecologists，不是 Rao。

ev.q: For the first two or three years the site is weeded and watered, after which it is left to look after itself.

7.why: C段。the point at which human care of a site comes to an end ↔ For the first two or three years … after which it is left to look after itself。

ev.q: The first in the Netherlands was planted in the town of Zaandam in 2015

8.why: A段。two countries ↔ the Netherlands（Zaandam，2015）和 Britain（Witney，2020）。B段讲的是日本的方法起源，不是“第一片小森林”在哪里。

ev.q: a tiny forest is considerably more expensive per tree than a conventional planting scheme

9.why: G段。a comparison of the expense of two planting approaches ↔ more expensive per tree than a conventional planting scheme。A段 affordable 只是支持者的形容，没有比较。

ev.q: may divert attention and funding from protecting existing woodland and old trees

10.why: F段末句。resources may be taken away ↔ divert attention and funding；other conservation work ↔ protecting existing woodland and old trees。

ev.q: about three saplings per square metre

11.why: C段。In each square metre ↔ per square metre；are put in the ground ↔ planted。不要填 species：thirty or more 指的是物种数量，不是每平方米种几棵。

ev.q: can make little difference to the amount of carbon removed from the atmosphere

12.why: E段。little effect on the quantity of ↔ make little difference to the amount of；taken out of the air ↔ removed from the atmosphere。

ev.q: Tiny forests are usually planted by local volunteers and schoolchildren

13.why: F段。generally done by ↔ usually planted by。schoolchildren 已在题干中给出，空格填 local volunteers；只填 volunteers 也对。residents 是 Rao 采访的对象，不是题目问的种树的人。
